verdicts.title: Strongly Homotopy Lie Algebras from Multisymplectic Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This Master Thesis is devoted to the study of $n$-plectic manifolds and the Strongly Homotopy Lie algebras, also called $L_{\infty}$-algebras, that can be associated to them.
